title: Toxicology LD50 for Minimum Poison Dose Crossing the Misalignment Threshold

original_idea.body:
# Toxicology LD50 for Minimum Poison Dose

**Problem:** Poisoning thresholds are not standardized across models or behaviors.

**Direction:** Estimate the minimum poisoned examples to push misalignment past a fixed threshold across several models and poison types via titrated LoRA; report a potency table.

**Why it matters:** A standardized poisoning-potency metric for data hygiene.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2509.19325; arXiv:2408.02946; arXiv:2502.17424.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A standardized poisoning-potency metric directly informs open-model data hygiene against a recognized threat.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Titrated LoRA fine-tunes plus threshold estimation; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused potency-table but spans several models and poison types.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models, public data; weak lab incentive on a public potency standard.

low_compute.reasoning: Many titrated LoRA fine-tunes across models on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Poisoning thresholds reported; a standardized cross-model LD50 metric may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Thresholds reported; standardized cross-model potency metric may be open.
